project: Weave Self-Iteration PR CI Vulncheck Repair
description: Small Ralph self-iteration focused on repairing the current pull-request Go CI govulncheck failure while keeping the security gate actionable for Weave's OSv2 service and upper-layer experience work. PR CI run 26035571895 failed after the prior gofmt repair because govulncheck found reachable vulnerabilities in the pinned Go toolchain, golang.org/x/net, and test-only Docker client utilities.

userStories.name: Make PR vulncheck gate actionable
userStories.description: Repair the current PR govulncheck failure by moving CI onto a fixed Go patch/toolchain, updating vulnerable reachable runtime dependencies, and making the vulncheck target exclude package-only testcontainer helpers whose Docker/Moby findings have no fixed version and are not part of the production/service scan. Keep CI and local `make vulncheck` aligned so future findings remain reproducible.
bdd_acceptance: Given the CI Go job installs Go from go.mod, When the workflow runs on a fresh runner, Then it uses a Go version at or above the fixed patch level for the standard-library findings reported by govulncheck.

Given the PR CI job reaches the security scan, When it invokes govulncheck, Then it uses the same scripted package scope as local `make vulncheck` instead of an ad hoc raw `govulncheck ./...` command.

Given package-only testcontainer helpers import Docker/Moby APIs with no fixed version, When the production vulncheck package list is built, Then internal test utility packages are excluded while production server, CLI, SDK, connector, and service packages remain scanned.

Given golang.org/x/net has reachable HTTP/2 findings in the current scan, When dependencies are resolved, Then the selected module version is at or above the fixed release and `make vulncheck` exits successfully.
ci_evidence: GitHub PR #16 run 26035571895 on 2026-05-18 failed Go / govulncheck with exit code 3.
CI log reported reachable standard-library vulnerabilities fixed in later Go patch releases, including `net/mail` fixed in go1.25.2.

Local reproduction on 2026-05-18 with `go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@latest ./...` failed under local go1.26.0 and reported standard-library findings fixed in go1.26.3, `golang.org/x/net@v0.50.0` findings fixed in v0.53.0, and Docker/Moby testcontainer findings with no fixed version.
Official Go release history lists go1.26.3 as released 2026-05-07 with security fixes for the Go command, pack tool, html/template, net, net/http, net/http/httputil, net/mail, and syscall.

Red on 2026-05-18: `go test ./scripts/ci -run TestBDD_GovulncheckGateUsesFixedToolchainAndActionableScope -count=1 -v` failed because go.mod pinned 1.25.0, CI ran raw `govulncheck ./...`, the Makefile did not delegate to a shared script, and the script did not exist.
Green on 2026-05-18: `make vulncheck` passed and reported zero reachable vulnerabilities.
